page_title: TOR 0-0 JUV | Torino v Juventus 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Juventus will take a free kick near the side line.
90+5' A substitution has been made. Andrea Cambiaso is replaced by Carlos Alcaraz (Juventus).
90+4' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) storms into the middle of the box and connects with a smart cross from Karol Linetty, the keeper is helpless but the header flies just over the bar.
90+2' Karol Linetty (Torino) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Ivan Juric, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
86' Wojciech Szczesny (Juventus) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
86' A player from Torino commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Juventus have been awarded a free kick.
86' Corner kick. Torino will have an opportunity.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Raoul Bellanova leaves the pitch and Adam Masina (Torino) comes on.
82' David Okereke (Torino) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
80' Danilo (Juventus) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
79' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
78' A substitution has been made. Federico Gatti goes off and Alex Sandro (Juventus) comes on.
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Dusan Vlahovic walks off the pitch to be replaced by Moise Kean (Juventus).
78' Ivan Juric prepares a substitution. Mergim Vojvoda is replaced by Valentino Lazaro (Torino).
77' The game has come to an end for Antonio Sanabria. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of David Okereke (Torino).
76' Karol Linetty (Torino) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Fabio Maresca had an easy-decision to make.

76' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom right corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic made a crucial save!

74' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) was waiting for the ball on the edge of the box and produced a powerful volley directed to the left side of the target, but the goalkeeper made an amazing save to deny him.
72' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Torino, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
72' Karol Linetty (Torino) is penalised for a foul. Fabio Maresca had a clear view and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Juventus.
71' The resulting corner from Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) was quite harsh and Fabio Maresca didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
66' Torino can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
65' An attempted cross from Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) is cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Torino will have a corner.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is coming onto the pitch as Federico Chiesa cannot continue after picking up an injury.
64' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Filip Kostic will be replaced by Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus).
64' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) commits a rough challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for an infringement. That's a free kick to Torino.

62' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is well positioned to make a comfortable save.

60' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Wojciech Szczesny dived superbly to block the header from around the penalty spot, which was aimed straight towards the bottom left corner by Antonio Sanabria (Torino).
60' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

59' Samuele Ricci (Torino) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Torino get a corner.
56' A cross by Raoul Bellanova (Torino) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
53' The resulting corner from Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) is cleared by the defence.
52' Samuele Ricci (Torino) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
51' Filip Kostic (Juventus) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Torino have a free kick.
50' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Torino win a free kick.
47' Goal disallowed! Duvan Zapata (Torino) scores but Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
45+4' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
45+3' Samuele Ricci (Torino) attempts to discuss the decision with Fabio Maresca, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Fabio Maresca shows a yellow card to Federico Gatti (Juventus) for his blatant foul.
42' Raoul Bellanova dinks a cheeky lofted pass into Nikola Vlasic (Torino), but his headed effort from near the penalty spot goes narrowly wide of the left post.
41' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Raoul Bellanova, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
40' A lofted cross from Nikola Vlasic (Torino) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
39' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
39' Federico Gatti (Juventus) is able to continue to play.
38' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
38' Federico Gatti (Juventus) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
37' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
36' Federico Gatti (Juventus) was too forceful with his tackle and Fabio Maresca interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick to Torino.
34' Karol Linetty (Torino) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
33' Filip Kostic (Juventus) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
31' Juventus earn a corner.

31' Great save! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
30' The referee blows his whistle as Bremer (Juventus) was too aggressive in his challenge. Torino get a free kick.
29' The Juventus players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
26' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle and it's Duvan Zapata (Torino) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. A free kick is awarded to Juventus.
25' Flag up against Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
24' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

23' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play and Torino manage to earn a corner.
22' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Torino earn a free kick.
21' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle after Filip Kostic (Juventus) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Torino have a free kick.
18' Duvan Zapata (Torino) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Juventus will take a free kick.
16' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but Wojciech Szczesny comes off his line to gather the ball.
15' Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) trips an opposition player and Fabio Maresca signals a foul. Juventus have a free kick.
13' CHANCE! Andrea Cambiaso finds Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just over the bar!
10' Karol Linetty (Torino) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wojciech Szczesny intercepts the ball.

7' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball bounced away off the left post!
6' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
3' The resulting set piece from Juventus is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

2' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out of play and Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Juventus will have the kick-off.
The players are on the pitch and Torino will have the kick-off.
Torino will kick-off.
Fabio Maresca was nominated as the referee for this game.
